intent.proves: Every data model (GroupType 2) in the default language that holds products has a completeness rule assigned.
intent.scope: Legacy registry scope; defaultLanguage/pimShop/productScope tokens where present. Global scans remain global; at least one subject must be in scope

bindings.reason: Requires complete joins and raw/fallback semantics parity before this binding may execute.

bindings.query: SELECT DISTINCT CAST(g.GroupId AS nvarchar(50)) + N' ' + CAST(g.GroupName AS nvarchar(100)) FROM EcomGroups g WHERE g.GroupType = 2 AND g.GroupLanguageId = N'{lang}' AND ISNULL(g.GroupCompletionRules, N'') = N'' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomGroupProductRelation r WHERE r.GroupProductRelationGroupId = g.GroupId)
bindings.subjectsQuery: SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT g.GroupId) FROM EcomGroups g WHERE g.GroupType = 2 AND g.GroupLanguageId = N'{lang}' AND EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM EcomGroupProductRelation r WHERE r.GroupProductRelationGroupId = g.GroupId)
